name: cpu_pointcloud
title: Point cloud processing
short_description: Downsampling, neighbour search and ICP alignment of lidar scans.

structured_text.description: Processes a bundled sequence of lidar style scans the way robot localisation does it: voxel downsampling, normal estimation from nearest neighbours and iterative closest point alignment of every scan against a map. The scans and parameters are fixed, and the work runs on all cores.
structured_text.metric_explanation: The score is the number of scans aligned per second.
structured_text.value_interpretation: Higher is better. More scans per second means a vehicle or robot can localise at its full sensor rate with time to spare.
structured_text.reasoning: Point cloud processing is dominated by spatial data structures and nearest neighbour searches, so it stresses memory latency, caches and floating point math in a pattern no other task covers.
